Decision record: retry policy for outbound webhooks

We will retry failed webhook deliveries up to eight times over 24 hours, with delays of 1, 5, 15, 30, 60, 180, 360, and 720 minutes. Only responses with status 5xx or a connection timeout count as retryable; a 4xx response stops the retries and marks the delivery as failed.

Customers can replay failed deliveries from the dashboard for 14 days. Tanaka raised the option of a longer window, but that period matches the retention of the event log, so we kept them aligned.

This decision takes effect with release 2.19.
